name: Physics
description: Rigid-body simulation driven through the renderer adapter (Havok under Babylon, a pure-core Euler integrator under Three or the mock). Once a sibling MeshPrimitive's handle is ready the system auto-creates a body (`physicsCreateBody`) and steps it each frame, emitting `physics.body.created` / `physics.body.disposed`. Input events let you set velocity, gravity, restitution, the fixed simulation rate, collider visibility, and pause/resume the simulation. Per-body shape, mass, friction, restitution, and motion type are configured on the component.
